Description: A media-director run is judged on confirming the render target before planning shots, producing a spec-complete storyboard, accounting for the runtime, and never rendering ahead of sign-off.

Criteria.Name: Dispatch behaved as declared
Criteria.Statement: The run did not behave the way the fixture declares, so nothing downstream of it can be trusted.

Criteria.Name: Confirmed the render target first
Criteria.Statement: Shots were laid out without reading the render profile.

Criteria.Name: Storyboard is spec-complete
Criteria.Statement: A storyboard without per-shot duration and a stated frame size cannot be rendered.

Criteria.Name: Held the render gate
Criteria.Statement: Frames were produced before the storyboard was signed off.

Criteria.Name: Runtime accounted for
Criteria.Statement: A teaser with no stated total runtime cannot be checked against the brief.
